newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU committee voting Thursday on rice import duties.
newsitem.headline: EU committee voting Thursday on rice import duties.

text.p: The European Union's cereals management committee is due to vote on Thursday on the latest Commission proposal to end the dispute with the U.S. over rice import duties, an EU official said on Wednesday.
The draft proposal for a cumulative tariff recovery system was scheduled for two days of discussion by rice experts on Wednesday and Thursday before the vote on their recommendation.
"The proposal is expected to be put to a vote on Thursday although some member states have indicated that they may abstain," the official said.
U.S. officials said the latest proposal might not break the 18-month dispute over how rules allowing traders to reclaim overpaid duties should be applied.

"The fact that the vote is scheduled indicates that progress has been made in bilateral negotiations but the question still remains as to whether the Commission can get enough member states on board," a U.S. source in Brussels said.
Last month EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler rejected a Spanish demand that agriculture ministers should take over the negotiations.

He told farm ministers that the threat of a complaint to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in Geneva continued and that to take the responsibility for negotiations away from the cereals management committee would not help.
